assumptions: scripts/make-invariant-review-bundle.sh is source-tree-only evidence — shipped to be read, not runnable from the archive
attrs.evidence: Two mechanisms, and neither is a copy list. The bundle stages the TRANSITIVE IMPORT CLOSURE of every named witness, derived by walking the imports — a hand-maintained set of files to copy is the same bug with an extra step. And check-claim-ledger.mjs walks each `.mjs` witness's relative-import graph and refuses a witness whose closure does not resolve, which makes the ledger checker its own hermeticity gate: a missing module fails that command FROM THE EXTRACTION and the generator deletes the archive. The law suite is then executed from the extraction at reduced trials as an executability proof. The first run after this landed was refused by its own gate, because this record named the generator and the generator was not staged.

coverage.domain: every `.mjs` witness named by any record in this ledger, plus the transitive relative-import closure of each

attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6 round-3 audit specified the two acceptable fixes; both are implemented.
attrs.statement: Every `.mjs` witness named by a ledger claim can be loaded from the review bundle, and the checker refuses one that cannot.
